summary.zh-Hant: 拉布拉多半島內陸的歸屬：加拿大與紐芬蘭長期爭執，雙方同意交樞密院司法委員會裁決；1927-03-01 裁決把爭議地區幾乎全判給紐芬蘭。裁決以前兩方的主張並存，本系統不裁判當時誰有理。
summary.en: Ownership of the interior of the Labrador Peninsula: long disputed between Canada and Newfoundland and referred by consent to the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council, which on 1 March 1927 awarded practically the whole disputed territory to Newfoundland. Before the decision both claims stood side by side.

position.zh-Hant: 主張拉布拉多內陸屬加拿大（魁北克省），紐芬蘭只有沿岸。出處：加拿大年鑑 1926 p. 1036（己方官方記載，A 級）。
position.en: Claimed the Labrador interior as part of Canada (Quebec), leaving Newfoundland only the coast. Source: Canada Year Book 1926, p. 1036 (own official record, grade A).

position.zh-Hant: 主張拉布拉多內陸屬紐芬蘭。目前只有對手方（加拿大年鑑）的記載提到這項主張，紐芬蘭自己的出處與裁決本文都還沒取得，所以這一方的範圍取自資料集，是待查證。
position.en: Claimed the Labrador interior. So far attested only by the opposing side (Canada Year Book); no Newfoundland source or text of the decision has been obtained, so this extent comes from the dataset and is pending verification.
